axiom_audit.command: nix develop path:. -c lake env lean /tmp/foundation-mac-local-realization-audit.lean

established: Arbitrary adaptive programs: public transcript, result, coin cursor, and final local invariant follow from one-query laws.
True early rejection in the replay interpreter preserves candidate, public signing transcript, verdict, and coin cursor.
Association-list and indexed partial-map stores are instantiated from entry-local laws.
A world-retaining common public-observation joint is constructed for arbitrary model families with heterogeneous private states.
The selected 4-message, 256-tag attack has equal public replay observations for 8 store/memo/early configurations.
Concrete replay backend-call log lengths are checked; no native machine cost claim is made.
remaining_inputs: The library chooses a common retained function and coin-tape semantics.
A law for that world is supplied; no uniform law on an infinite coin-tape type is constructed.
A new model needs a local invariant, an initial-state proof, and one-query preservation/response proofs.
not_established: The world law or global correspondence is extracted from arbitrary unrelated probabilistic couplings.
The new replay marginals equal independent lazy-sampling Program.run marginals.
Higher cells are used or necessary: all new theorems use ordinary structural induction and shared invariants.
Proof-size, checking-time, user-effort, or cryptographic-security-loss advantage over an ordinary shared-lemma baseline.
A novel general local-to-global or coupling theorem.
